mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expenses (household_id, payer_user_id, category_id, account_id, amount, purpose, memo, expense_date, include_in_household_total, created_at) VALUES (#{householdId}, #{payerUserId}, #{categoryId}, #{accountId}, #{amount}, #{purpose}, #{memo}, #{expenseDate}, #{includeInHouseholdTotal}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, household_id, payer_user_id, category_id, account_id, amount, purpose, memo, expense_date, include_in_household_total, created_at FROM expenses WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expenses WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expenses WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
